machine: Apple M4, 10 cores, 16 GB RAM, macOS 26 (Darwin 25.5.0)

report.note: final run; wall time inflated by disk contention from another project's job on the same drive

deviations: The genome-hash check in calls first compared a provenance field that does not exist, so it never ran. Fixed before any capture result was read (decision 0008, corrections after freezing); all 10,521 call sets pass the corrected check.

The first context build read the NA determinant status that PR #14 writes for the 2,826 mapping-uncertain endpoints as genotype unavailable, putting 805 false negatives under R_GENOTYPE_UNAVAILABLE. endpoint_status now takes the PR #7 status (uncertain) for endpoints that have calls, and context was rebuilt; the rule in decision 0008 did not change.
The first report run stopped with a KeyError: perf() did not return the endpoint counts N, N_R and N_S listed in its output fields. They were added and the report was rerun; no metric changed.

_spearman() now returns no coefficient for a constant input instead of NaN, and audit writes NA instead of an empty detail field. Both were found by the tests or by git diff --check; no association in the real run had a constant input. audit was rerun from its checkpoint and report was rerun with the final code; every committed table was identical apart from the detail column, gzip timestamps and generated_at.
The augmented runs shared the machine with an alignment job from another project for part of the time; task times are not representative of an idle machine. Free memory stayed above 25%.
not_committed: prediction_error_context.tsv.gz (about 76 MB), amr_calls.tsv.gz, mutation_capture.tsv.gz (the per-call copy is committed as mutation_capture.tsv), audit_checkpoint.jsonl, the augmented task predictions under augmented/, and mechanism_catalogue_snapshot.tsv (a row subset of the committed catalogue); all stay in datasets/ecoli_research_v1/error_decomposition_v1/ and are rebuilt by the commands above
